title: Two for One: Privileged Bilateral Learning for Monocular Retinal Disease Classification
description: We thus propose a privileged learning framework in which a teacher model has access to bilateral CFP images during training and learns representations informed by information from both eyes, while the student is trained to transfer this knowledge from the bilateral teacher using only a single-eye image as input. At inference, the student operates exclusively on this single-eye input and does not require the contralateral image.

inputs.label: Eye at inference

inputs.label: Inter-eye correlation
inputs.description: How similar the disease signal is in the two eyes (0 = independent, 0.99 = identical)

inputs.label: Distillation weight α
inputs.description: Weight of the feature-distillation term; 0 = no distillation
